based_on: 1.2 plus the songwriting layer (melodic phrase shape, repeat cycle, bar-8 change rate) pooled over the reference set
privacy: Pooled, smoothed aggregate statistics only. No note sequences, motifs, rhythm cells, n-grams above first order, per-source tables, source counts or names.

conventions.grid: 16 slots per bar, 0-15 (0 = beat 1); kick steps 0/4/8/12
conventions.slot_class: beat s%4==0, e s%4==1, and s%4==2, a s%4==3; strong = beats, medium = 8th offbeats, weak = e/a
conventions.degree: pitch class above the roll tonic, 0-11 (0=1, 1=b2, 2=2, 3=b3, 5=4, 7=5, 8=b6, 9=6, 10=b7)
conventions.interval_bins: 27 bins, index i = signed semitones (i-13); 0 / 26 = beyond an octave
conventions.onset_prob: per-slot Bernoulli probability; the generator uses it as slot weights after drawing the bar count
conventions.density_curve: notes per bar for bars 1-8 of the phrase (mean, sd); means rescaled to density_median
conventions.distributions: every *_dist, unigram, transition row, voicing list and mode weight map sums to 1
conventions.bar_groups: body = bars 1-3 and 5-7, bar4 = the answer bar, bar8 = the turnaround bar

anti_copy.runtime: check every table after per-roll reshaping and before the mode mask; mix toward its prior in entropy_mix_step steps until it meets its floor; re-roll an 8-bar bass whose onset histogram is under floor - margin
generator_must: compose every lane fresh from these tables each roll; never store, cache or replay a phrase
re-roll any roll that fails the originality gate before output

songwriting.scope: pooled over every style; no single source above 35% of any statistic (largest 13.4%)
